notes: A real city: pick a place and get real OpenStreetMap streets, buildings, terrain, tunnels and subway lines, with cars, pedestrians, trams and trains moving on the real network, in a new 3D view (plus 2D map and Grid). Back button in every full view, working area picker, AI key panel in the city settings (your key is now remembered). Efficiency / Performance / Adaptive modes, and the city runs about twice as fast. Water-like ripples, stronger glass look, and many fixes.
